DETERMINATION: NOT-YET (C3a/C3b/C3c fail on accurate data). OPEN LANE (successor): a full ERCOT offer-curve + ORDC/co-opt re-calibration against the corrected availability envelope, so the real scarcity re-forms on real fleet tightness. CROSS-ISO: the detector is shared — PJM's committed facility csv shows a stronger phantom signature and all six ISOs' unit-level extracts use it; each ISO is its own regenerate-and-re-audit lane.
